title: A Song for the King
lines: Ben is a king with a red cap.
He can not sing well at all.
When he sings, his dogs run off.
A bug with a red wing sits on it.
It sang a long song for Ben.
Ben and the bug sang, and the dogs sat.
Was it the bug or the king? Both!

questions.ask: What do the dogs do when Ben sings on his own?
questions.listenFor: They run off. It is in the third line - have your child find the word dogs.

questions.ask: Who asks Ben to sing along?
questions.listenFor: The bug. Listen for them to connect the bug's line of talking with the dogs sitting down at the end.

questions.ask: Why do you think the dogs sat down that time? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. You want a reason tied to the story, like "the song was better with two of them."
